theorems.name: Submission.ltg_tau_congr_on_open
theorems.statement: ∀ (P k : ℕ) (M M' : Set (Eucl P)) (θ θ' : Eucl P → ℝ) (ξ ξ' : Eucl P → NVector (Eucl P) k) (V : Set (Eucl P)), IsOpen V → (μHE[k] : Measure (Eucl P)) (symmDiff M M' ∩ V) = 0 → (∀ᵐ x ∂((μHE[k] : Measure (Eucl P)).restrict (M ∩ V)), θ x = θ' x ∧ ξ x = ξ' x) → ∀ ω : DifferentialForm (Eucl P) k, tsupport ω ⊆ V → tauAction k M θ ξ ω = tauAction k M' θ' ξ' ω
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
